title: remaining gaps in indic_token_dict
verdict: DICTIONARY IS CORRECT. Not dead weight, not broken. One NEW structural defect: 16 of 167 values (9.58%) have exactly one key, and all 16 are Indian state/region words -> single-script coverage gap. France value exactly 0, France cost negligible. Cross-country collision impossible by construction.

reference_docs.D096_mine_indic_token_dict_India.md: DOES NOT EXIST in analysis_out/findings/ - only analysis_out/tasks/D096.json exists. Not waited for.

new_defect_single_script_state_coverage.explanation: Coverage gap in the learned table, faithful to its training data. learn_translit.py address branch records only the script observed in a given address; it never iterates over scripts.

control_contrast_gujarat.why: only state name with full 9-way fanout; appeared in the source-1 NAME alignment branch as well as the address branch

learner_mechanism.name_branch: learn_translit.py:41-48 - aligns native tokens to Latin tokens for business names; a name is the same word in 9 scripts so each concept accumulates 9 keys
learner_mechanism.address_branch: learn_translit.py:50-67 - fires only when source-1 address component is an IN_STATES key (:51,:55) and the native component contains Indic (:59); records only the script actually observed, once

collisions.cross_country_argument: All 1363 keys are pure U+0900-U+0D7F. Gate at normalize.py:91 is INDIC_RE.search(s), per-STRING not per-country. A US or France row must contain a literal Brahmic codepoint for the table to fire. Zero for US and every non-India country, by construction rather than by measurement.
collisions.lookup_mechanism: normalize.py:18 INDIC_TOKEN_RE = [U+0900-U+0D7F + ZWNJ/ZWJ]+ used with .sub() at :103. The + is GREEDY so it emits MAXIMAL runs. rep() does an EXACT whole-run hash lookup (:97,:100).
collisions.romanize_note: normalize.py:40 romanize() is a pure code-point loop and NEVER consults the dictionary. Therefore no prefix scan, no longest-match, no first-match ambiguity, and no key can shadow another.
collisions.work_order_first_vs_longest_match_questi: DOES NOT APPLY - it is a single exact dict lookup on a maximally-munched run
collisions.substring_harmless_reason: Maximal munch means a fragment and its superstring can never be candidates for the same input span, so they cannot disagree on any row. The raw count 131 would otherwise read as a serious defect.

multiword_values.space_is_required_not_broken: IN_STATES (normalize.py:231-242) is itself keyed on the space-joined form, so the space is necessary for the state to resolve.
multiword_values.address_path_trace: normalize_address:331 ck=re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9& ]+',' ',c) - the class INCLUDES the space (only non-alnum char preserved); :332 normalises; :333 if ck in smap matches; :334 sets state; :335 continues
multiword_values.name_path_trace: normalize_name:276 _non_alnum.split(s) splits on [^a-z0-9]+ so a name-borne 'west bengal' becomes tokens west, bengal
multiword_values.keys_py_safety: keys.py:33,39,46 all .str.split(' ') on space-joined columns, so no blocking key can contain a space

france_cost.verdict: NEGLIGIBLE - do not inflate. A country-scoping guard would be churn, not a fix.
france_cost.per_row_cost: one regex scan of a short Latin string, returns s at normalize.py:92. No dict lookup, no allocation, no romanize().
france_cost.dict_load_note: _load_dict() is called at :93 AFTER the INDIC_RE.search gate at :91, so a run containing no Brahmic anywhere never loads the 47,788-byte JSON.
france_cost.estimated_wall_clock: well under one second, once, for the entire France test set

latin_side_extension.verdict: CATEGORY ERROR, not a task. Re-keying this file on Latin would duplicate NAME_CANON / ADDR_CANON_COMMON / ADDR_CANON_FR / LEET / STATE_MAPS in a second, learned, strictly worse place. NOT PROPOSED.
latin_side_extension.reason: learn_translit.py:46 for x,y in zip(b,a) -- x is always the NATIVE token (dict key), y always the Latin token (dict value). :42 discards every pair whose source-2 name has no Brahmic. No code path or parameter could emit a Latin key.
latin_side_extension.legitimate_extension: Add the 8 missing scripts for the 16 single-key state values.

clean_checks.self_maps_note: Structurally impossible: keys are U+0900-U+0D7F, values match ^[a-z ]+$, disjoint by construction. D095 already called this class vacuous; not re-raised as a defect.
clean_checks.zwnj_double_lookup: normalize.py:100-101 is UNREACHABLE dead code because 0 keys contain ZWNJ/ZWJ. Benign, pre-established by D095.

name_stop_interaction.verdict: CORRECT BEHAVIOUR not a defect - llp/ltd/pvt are legal-form noise by design (NAME_STOP:145). The 6 ltd/pvt entries are exactly D095 affix fragments, and they are independently protected by maximal munch.

declared_gaps.india_brahmic_row_count: GAP - not collected, and not collectable from the current profile. build_profile.py:28 TOKEN_RE=[a-z0-9]+ matches ZERO characters of a Brahmic string and :110-111 applies it to the RAW untransliterated name. Every Brahmic token is invisible to every profile field. No estimate offered.
declared_gaps.profile_cannot_answer_dead_weight_questi: The profile is STRUCTURALLY incapable of answering the work order 'which entries are never fired' question for this table. Any such list would be invented. Declaring this a GAP is the correct output.
declared_gaps.rows_with_non_devanagari_script_state_na: GAP - the impact of the 16-single-key defect cannot be sized.
declared_gaps.top4000_caveat: name_tokens/addr_tokens are Counter.most_common(4000) over counters periodically pruned of count==1 (build_profile.py:26,45-48,128-133). Doubly truncated. Absence means 'not in the top 4000', never 'does not occur'.
declared_gaps.token_occurrences_not_rows: The profile counts TOKEN OCCURRENCES, never ROWS.
declared_gaps.profile_flattens_components: build_profile.py:126-127 splits addresses on [,;] and counts tokens per component; consuming code (normalize_address:333) matches whole components. Any downstream component-level claim needs its own trace.

measurement_artefact_warning.verdict: MEASUREMENT ARTEFACT, NOT INERTNESS. Do not quote this zero as evidence the table does nothing.
measurement_artefact_warning.proof_of_liveness: 1363 entries each backed by n>=2 real train observations (learn_translit.py:70-72) is proof that Brahmic-script text exists in India train S2/S3 at volume.

raw_counts_used_for_scale_only.note: RAW counts on the UNTRANSLITERATED field (build_profile.py:127). These are the destination the table converts INTO, not evidence of what it converted. Top-4000 truncated.

population_denominators.note: France appears ONLY in test_*, never in train_*. Verified across all six profile files. This is why the France-postcode and France-region hypotheses were dead on arrival.

recommended_change.propose_extend_state_scripts: SPECULATIVE - the only legitimate extension this file admits, but unmeasurable against the current profile. Needs the two counters below first.

closure_requirement.definition: count U+0900-U+0D7F in the RAW field
closure_requirement.cost: streaming any() tests, ~4 lines, same cost as the existing pass
closure_requirement.why: Without them this file can be audited for CORRECTNESS (done, clean) but never for COVERAGE (still open).

self_corrections: First check of the split-token state entries (madhya/pradesh/uttar in Devanagari) appeared to show them MISSING from the dictionary. That was my own transcription error - I typed the word madhya with a trailing matra instead of the correct form. The dictionary is correct and D095 section 4d is correct. Verified keys: madhya = U+092E U+0927 U+094D U+092F; pradesh = U+092A U+094D U+0930 U+0926 U+0947 U+0936; uttar = U+0909 U+0924 U+094D U+0924 U+0930.
